description.value: Sparkes Corn Barn is a family-owned, seasonal farm stand that has been growing and selling fresh-picked sweet corn in the Chilliwack area since 1998, operating as a drive-thru stand with multiple Fraser Valley locations. Corn is harvested daily and delivered directly from their fields to each stand the same day, with non-GMO varieties including Peaches-n-Cream and their signature Triple Sweet Jubilee. They also grow strawberries, raspberries, and blueberries, and appear at several regional farmers markets during the season.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Sparkes Corn Barn is a real, family-owned seasonal greengrocer operating drive-thru corn and berry stands across the Fraser Valley since 1998; the OSM address (34561 DeLair Road) matches the Abbotsford location listed on the website's Locations page. The website prominently states 'CLOSED FOR THE SEASON – 2025' and the OSM tag seasonal=summer confirms summer-only operation; the business is not permanently closed. No mention of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, or any cycling amenities appears on the website; basic groceries (corn, strawberries, raspberries, blueberries) are explicitly confirmed.
concerns: Business is seasonal (summer only); website shows 'CLOSED FOR THE SEASON – 2025' — will reopen for 2026 summer season.
OSM community field is listed as Chilliwack but the address (34561 DeLair Road, V2S 2E1) and website location listing place this specific stand in Abbotsford, not Chilliwack.
Phone number (778.704.0671) sourced from website contact page — OSM has no phone listed, so cross-check against OSM was not possible.
The main/head-office barn address per website contact page is 46265 Prairie Central Rd, Chilliwack, BC V2R 4L8, which differs from the OSM-tagged address for this specific stand location.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, operating seasonal produce stand with multiple locations; seasonal closure does not indicate permanent closure. Useful to cyclists seeking fresh local produce in the Fraser Valley.
enrichment_extras.notes: This OSM record represents one of several Sparkes stand locations. The website lists a DSD (direct store delivery) program contact at sparkesdsd@chilliwackcorn.com and 604.799.9577 for wholesale/store inquiries.
